plan_sections.FR-01: Define closed discovery, descriptor, liveness, and dashboard snapshot contracts. AC-01: Closed JSON schemas distinguish PlanGraphs, FeatureRuns, liveness, and unavailable evidence.
plan_sections.FR-02: Make PlanGraph executions durable, identifiable, resumable, and correlated with child FeatureRuns. AC-02: Every new PlanGraph writes a canonical audit directory and durable node checkpoint. AC-03: Every launched child is correlated by plan_graph_id, plan_node_id, and feature_run_id.
plan_sections.FR-03: Build the verified read model that discovers historical and live FeatureRuns and PlanGraphs. AC-04: Discovery projects terminal, active, stale, legacy, corrupt, and ungrouped runs without guessing. AC-05: A run is labeled live only when its same-host lease is fresh and its process identity matches. AC-06: One FeatureRun detail projection exposes lifecycle, criteria, tasks, findings, evidence metadata, Git custody, usage, and availability.
plan_sections.FR-04: Expose the run catalog through a bounded read-only local dashboard API. AC-07: The local API is read-only, path-contained, deterministic, ETag-enabled, and safe against symlinks and malformed journals.
plan_sections.FR-05: Connect the React Flow dashboard to real PlanGraph and FeatureRun data. AC-08: The dashboard renders discovered PlanGraphs and updates the selected FeatureRun inspector from API data. AC-09: Polling preserves selection and distinguishes running, queued, blocked, stale, terminal, and unavailable states.
plan_sections.FR-06: Certify the complete discovery-to-inspection workflow and document operation and migration. AC-10: End-to-end tests prove completed and live discovery, stale-run rejection, PlanGraph correlation, UI inspection, and legacy behavior.
